# Zeyad Deeb — Blog & Library

> Writing and saved references by Zeyad Deeb, a software engineer in Brooklyn.

- [Blog & Library](https://www.zeyaddeeb.com/blog): Recent writing and library selections.
- [Posts](https://www.zeyaddeeb.com/blog/posts): Articles on software, machine learning, and projects.
- [Library](https://www.zeyaddeeb.com/blog/library): Books, art, podcasts, videos, and links with personal notes.
- [About](https://www.zeyaddeeb.com/about): Author background.
- [Main site](https://www.zeyaddeeb.com/): Projects and interactive experiments.

Article URLs use /blog/posts/[slug]. Library entry URLs use /blog/library/[slug]. Use canonical URLs and the published dates shown on articles when citing them. Saved library works belong to their original creators; the accompanying notes are by Zeyad Deeb.
